messages.subject: Installation of ggplot2 failed???
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to install ggplot2 on a Linux box, but I am getting the following error.

** preparing package for lazy loading
Error : package 'proto' does not have a namespace
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package 'ggplot2'
* removing '/usr/local/lib64/R/library/ggplot2'

any idea?

Here are the specifics of my installation:

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.14.2 (2012-02-29)
Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=fr_CA             LC_NUMERIC=C              LC_TIME=fr_CA                   LC_COLLATE=fr_CA   
 [5] LC_MONETARY=en_US    LC_MESSAGES=fr_CA    LC_PAPER=C                     LC_NAME=C          
 [9] LC_ADDRESS=C              LC_TELEPHONE=C         LC_MEASUREMENT=fr_CA LC_IDENTIFICATION=C

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tcltk_2.14.2 tools_2.14.2
>

Thanks for any support,

Gérald Jean

messages.author: 8a91737817761d9c
messages.subject: Re: Installation of ggplot2 failed???
parts:
Problem solved!!!

I reinstalled the package "proto" and afterwards the installation of "ggplot2" succeeded without a glitch!!

Thanks,

Gérald
